songs.name: And We Bid You Good Night

ai_show_review.summary: Fresh Feedback fragment captured in crystal‑clear soundboard mix
ai_show_review.blurb: The March 31 1968 Carousel Ballroom set is a tight three‑song burst featuring a standout, freshly rendered "Feedback". The soundboard recording is exceptionally clear, while the audience tape offers a high‑octane glimpse despite early muffling. Ideal for fans wanting a concise taste of late‑60s Dead energy.
ai_show_review.review: On March 31, 1968 the Grateful Dead took the Carousel Ballroom into a brief but potent three‑song run: "Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks)" segues into an inspired take on the Anthem of the Sun jam "Feedback," before closing with the gentle send‑off “And We Bid You Good Night.”  The best source, a soundboard capture (gd68-03-31.aud.cotsman.14913.sbeok.shnf), is described as “way too clear” – an almost studio‑like fidelity that lets every nuance of the experimental feedback section shine without dropouts or muddiness.  A contemporaneous audience recording (gd1968-03-31.sbd.miller.108995.flac16) is less pristine, with the opening two tracks muffled, but still conveys the high‑octane, party‑like atmosphere of a 1968 Dead appetizer.  Together they paint a vivid snapshot of the band in transition, offering both an immaculate listening experience and a raw, live feel for completists.

best_recording.reason: Excellent soundboard source with crystal‑clear mix and no technical flaws, showcasing the standout Feedback segment perfectly.

key_highlights: Standout, fresh rendition of "Feedback" from the Anthem of the Sun suite
Exceptionally clear soundboard capture that reveals every detail
High‑octane, concise three‑song set capturing late‑60s Dead energy
must_listen_sequences: And We Bid You Good Night
